source_refs.locator: PDF physical p.43 (printed p.38), Annex I paragraph 4.

evidence.scenario: One-SD soil-moisture deficit in SVAR/DSGE; not an emissions scenario.
evidence.compact_statement: The IMF's modeled one-standard-deviation soil-moisture deficit shock produces a peak GDP contraction around 0.3% after three quarters, with primary-sector effects persisting for two years in SVAR and up to five in DSGE. This is a model experiment, not an observed or calendar-year forecast.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
